title: Obtain and renew a Texas electrical contractor license
authority: Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation
description: A business designing, installing, erecting, repairing or altering electrical wiring or conductors in Texas must hold an Electrical Contractor license. The business must employ or be owned by a licensed Master Electrician, maintain the required liability insurance and submit the $110 application fee; the license is valid for one year and renews annually.
renewal: Renew annually with the $110 non-refundable renewal fee; maintain the required liability insurance and a qualifying Master Electrician of Record.
